intro_strings: As the cats move along the shoreline, they spot something massive moving beneath the water.
decline_strings: The cats are feeling remarkably incurious today.

strings: It's Nessie! The patrol trots up, exchanging a nice mouse for a nice deep-water fish, both creatures trading the respective delicacies that are hard for the other to obtain.

The patrol is so wrapped up trying to work out what the creature is that r_c0 topples into the water. It solves the mystery though, as Nessie propels r_c0 back onto the shoreline with one gentle, immense flipper.

strings: The massive frog-Twoleg creeps up the rocks, slow and unnatural. The patrol watches, breathless, until it's out of sight. Well, p_l huffs. Maybe toads grow bigger than {PRONOUN/p_l/subject} thought. Terrifying.

Frozen, the cats watch the massive lumbering frog, the size of a Twoleg and just as bipedal. It halts and, like the rumble of thunder, issues a massive croak that creaks like cracking wood. All r_c0 can do is shiver.
